policies.title: EU Member State ordinary passports: short-stay visa waiver
policies.summary: The operative EU–FSM agreement directly waives visas for citizens of the 26 listed EU Member States holding valid ordinary passports for short stays.
conditions: The agreement defines its Member-State scope as EU Member States other than the United Kingdom and Ireland; it directly covers ordinary passports and is not extended here to EFTA, United Kingdom, Irish or other passports.
The treaty waiver is for up to 90 days in any 180-day period and does not apply to travel for a paid activity.

The waiver preserves FSM entry and short-stay conditions and individual refusal of entry. It does not decide employment, residence, study, transit, crew, diplomatic, official, service, special-document or case-specific treatment.

policies.title: Other foreign ordinary passports: permit-free visits of up to 30 days
policies.summary: FSM Embassy entry guidance states a destination-wide rule: a permit is not required for a person visiting the FSM for 30 days or less. This policy records that direct universal short-visit rule outside the separately evidenced EU treaty cohort.
conditions: This is a direct universal rule for a person visiting for 30 days or less, not a nationality complement inferred from omission or an application form.
For a visit exceeding 30 days, the Embassy guidance requires an entry permit. The resulting longer-visit process is not normalized here as an eVisa, ETA or visa on arrival.

The Embassy guidance requires a passport valid for at least 120 days after entry and completion of the FSM Immigration Arrival and Departure Record on arrival where the visitor has no valid entry permit. The arrival record is a declaration, not an ETA or visa.

The separate longer-visit treatment stated for United States, Marshall Islands and Palau citizens/nationals does not change the direct permit-free classification for an ordinary short visit of 30 days or less.

This policy does not decide employment, residence, business or contract work beyond the ordinary short tourist visit; it also does not decide passport/document acceptance, diplomatic, official, service, special-passport, transit, crew, health or individual-admissibility cases.

policies.title: FSM citizens: national entry category
policies.summary: The official FSM entry material treats FSM citizens and nationals as their own travel-document category; its universal up-to-30-day no-permit rule also does not impose an entry permit on a person visiting the FSM.
conditions: This records the catalog's same-country citizenship relationship only. It is not a foreign visitor-visa classification.
